verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents search operators and lets Splits use complex search queries. Its AI assistant can search the entire email history, and a how-to covers importing full history beyond the default 90 days. However, community reports say the free plan drops mail older than 90 days from search, and nothing documents search speed or relevance ranking. Missing for 10: evidence of fast search performance, ranked/relevance-ordered results, documented filter depth beyond operators, full history searchable on all plans.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Search operators in Shortwave make locating threads and messages simple.
You can define Splits based on: Importance, Built-in labels... Custom labels, Specific senders, Complex search queries
it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more.
On the free plan, emails older than 90 days don't appear in search and pre-signup history beyond 90 days isn't imported.
